record.question: Congenital toxoplasmosis is most severe when infection occurs during:
record.explanation: Answer A: First trimester. Congenital toxoplasmosis acquired earlier in pregnancy tends to produce more severe fetal damage, although transmission probability generally increases later in gestation. Hence the answer concerns severity, not transmission likelihood. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/toxoplasmosis/symptoms/index.html; https://www.cdc.gov/dpdx/toxoplasmosis/index.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
